This page hosts the 2026 SnoutCounter House forecast. A blue wave in the House is widely expected as Trump's approval continues to crater and sentiment on the economy and the direction of the country worsens. Despite extensive mid-decade redistricting, which has generally benefited Republicans, Democrats are still favored to win the House.

You can read about how the model that powers this forecast works [here](2026-house-forecast-release-article.qmd). The source code is publicly available on [GitHub](https://github.com/Hackquantumcpp/snoutcounter-midterms-2026-model).

Below you can find a map of seat chances and projections, as well as some overall summary stats. Note: Datawrapper's map still uses the 2026 gerrymander for Missouri, but that map has since been struck down and replaced with the old map used for 2022 and 2024.

Additionally, you can see how the forecasted odds and vote shares have changed for each individual congressional seat below.

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd
from shiny import *
from shiny.express import input, render, ui
from shinywidgets import render_widget

output_ts = pd.read_csv('../../snoutcounter-midterms-2026-model/prediction/house/model_output/output_over_time.csv')

output_ts = output_ts[output_ts['type'].isin(['chance', 'y_pred', 'ci_low', 'ci_hi'])]

seats = dict(zip(output_ts['geo'], output_ts['geo']))

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
  ui.layout_columns(
    ui.input_selectize(
      "cd",
      "Congressional District:",
      seats
    ),
    ui.input_radio_buttons(
      "type_disp",
      "",
      {"1": "Win probability", "2": "Vote share"}
    ),
    col_widths=[6, 6]
  ),
  ui.output_plot("plot")
)

def server(input, output, session):
  @output
  @render_plotly
  def plot():
    disp_output = output_ts[(output_ts['geo'] == input.cd()) & (output_ts['type'] == input.type_disp())]
    disp_output['Republicans'] = disp_output['y'].map(lambda x: 100 - x)
    disp_output = disp_output.rename({'y': 'Democrats'}, axis=1)
    
    disp_yaxis = "Win Probability" if input.type_disp() == "Win probability" else "Vote Share"
    
    chart = px.line(disp_output, x='date', y=['Democrats', 'Republicans'], template='plotly_white', color_discrete_map={'Democrats': '#004b97', 'Republicans': '#c71e1d'})
    chart = chart.update_traces(hovertemplate="%{y:.1f}%")
    chart.update_layout(
      xaxis=dict(range=[disp_output['date'].min(), pd.to_datetime('2026-11-10')]),
      yaxis=dict(range=[0, 100]),
      xaxis_title='Date',
      yaxis_title=f'{disp_yaxis} (%)',
      title=dict(text=f"{input.cd()} {disp_yaxis} Over Time"),
      hovermode="x",
      showlegend=False
    )
    
    return chart

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
